blanca-nava.text: (2023) As board president, joined Andrew Ramirez and Dominique Ballante at a Dec. 28, 2023 special meeting in firing Superintendent Terry Walker without cause, four days before SB 494's 72-hour notice requirement took effect; the trio named Priya Darbari interim superintendent.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Hundreds decry Keppel leader's ouster (2024-01-18)

blanca-nava.text: (2024) Defended the Dec. 28 meeting, saying she posted the agenda 24 hours ahead as required and conducted it legally with district counsel present; said the meeting was meant to start Walker's evaluation and asked the community to give the board a chance.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel chief meeting legally posted (2024-01-04)

blanca-nava.text: (2023) Voted against Superintendent Walker's employment contract on Aug. 15, 2023, saying she had just returned from vacation and had not had time to read it.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel chief meeting legally posted (2024-01-04)

blanca-nava.text: (2024) Voted for an 18-month interim contract for Darbari (3-1), saying it was based on a salary survey: "We cannot be unrealistic and provide something less to a person that is taking to the position and they're going to be doing the same type of job."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel approves interim contract (2024-02-08)

blanca-nava.text: (2024) Voted with the 3-2 majority to give Darbari a four-year superintendent contract at $220,000 a year: "You're surprised that she's been an official for the past four months; she's doing awesome."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel approves 4-year contract for superintendent (2024-04-04)

blanca-nava.text: (2024) As board president, denied trustee Waunette Cullors's request at a Jan. 16 meeting for the business chief to state how much the district was spending on two former superintendents, other dismissals and legal fees.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Hundreds decry Keppel leader's ouster (2024-01-18)

blanca-nava.text: (2024) Backed reclassifying the superintendent's secretary to work under the board majority after staff allegedly were told not to help post the Dec. 28 agenda: "It's a way of actually being able to protect for the district and for the board to be able to move forward."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel waits to reclassify secretary (2024-02-10)
